module: Module 6: Independent Sub-Account Margin, Leverage & Stop-Outs
title: Master Terminal Awareness of Sub-Account Stop-Out
precondition: Sub-account #3 is liquidated due to stop-out.
expected_result: Master terminal alerts manager: 'Sub-account #3 liquidated at 50% margin level'; active group equity and lot sizing recalculate.
actual_result: Master terminal WebSocket updates display sub-account liquidation event and automatically re-calibrates active group capital.
